SETTLEMENT_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The settlement date cannot be in the future.
SETTLEMENT_EXCEEDS_PENDING: This {{paymentTypeCode}} settlement of ₹{{amount}} is more than the ₹{{pending}} still pending for {{paymentTypeCode}}. Check the amount, or close the shifts whose collections it covers first.
SETTLEMENT_PAYMENT_TYPE_INVALID: Invalid payment type '{{paymentType}}'. Must be UPI, card or fleet card.
SETTLEMENT_RECENT_DUPLICATE: An identical {{paymentTypeCode}} settlement of ₹{{amount}} for {{settlementDate}} was recorded in the last 2 minutes. Refresh the list before recording it again.
SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: A settlement amount must be more than zero.
SETTLEMENT_CHARGES_NEGATIVE: MDR and GST on MDR cannot be negative.
SETTLEMENT_CHARGES_EXCEED_AMOUNT: The bank charges are as large as the settlement of ₹{{amount}}. Check the MDR and GST amounts.
SETTLEMENT_GST_WITHOUT_MDR: Enter the MDR amount along with the GST on it.
SETTLEMENT_MATCHED_TO_BANK_LINE: This settlement is matched to the bank statement line of {{txnDate}}. Unmatch that line in Bank reconciliation before voiding the settlement.
SHIFT_BALANCE_SHEET_ALREADY_EXISTS: A balance sheet for "{{shiftName}}" on {{reportDate}} already exists (ID {{balanceSheetId}}). Delete it first to regenerate.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DIFFERS: All shift definitions in a batch must start on the same date.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_EFFECTIVE_TO_DIFFERS: All shift definitions in a batch must end on the same date.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_EXCEED_24_HOURS: The combined duration of all shifts exceeds 24 hours ({{totalMinutes}} minutes). Reduce the shift windows.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_OVERLAP: Shift "{{firstShiftName}}" overlaps with "{{secondShiftName}}". Shift windows must not overlap.
SHIFT_DEFINITION_REQUIRED: At least one shift definition is required.
SHIFT_HISTORY_FILTER_CONFLICT: Filter shift history by fuel or by discrepancies, not both.
SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: Shift is not open. Current status: {{statusCode}}
SHIFT_PLAN_PUBLISHED_CANNOT_REGENERATE: This week's plan is already published and cannot be regenerated.
SHIFT_PLAN_WEEK_IN_PAST: Cannot generate a plan for a week entirely in the past. Navigate to the current or a future week.
SHIFT_REPORT_REQUIRES_SHIFT_DEFINITION: A shift report needs a shift. Select one from the dropdown.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_ALREADY_DISABLED: This shift schedule has already been disabled. Delete it and create a new one if needed.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_DISABLE_DATE_BEFORE_START: Disable date ({{disableDate}}) cannot be before the schedule start date ({{effectiveFrom}}).
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_IN_USE: Cannot delete this shift schedule — shifts have already been recorded against it. You can only delete schedules that have never been used.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No shift schedule has been configured for this pump. Ask an admin to set up shift definitions under Pump Settings.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_OVERLAPS_OPEN_SCHEDULE: The date range [{{effectiveFrom}} – {{effectiveTo}}] overlaps with an active schedule effective from {{existingFrom}}. Disable or delete the conflicting group first.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_OVERLAPS_SCHEDULE: The date range [{{effectiveFrom}} – {{effectiveTo}}] overlaps the schedule {{existingFrom}} – {{existingTo}}. Delete that schedule or choose dates that do not overlap it.
SHIFT_SORT_ORDER_NOT_UNIQUE: Each shift must have a unique sort order.
STAFF_CREATE_ONLY_FOR_OWN_PUMP: You can only create staff for pump {{pumpId}}
STAFF_ROLE_REQUIRES_PUMP: {{roleCode}} must be assigned to a pump
STOCK_LOTS_SHORT_OF_TANK_STOCK: The stock lots for tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' hold {{shortfall}} L less than the recorded tank stock, so this change cannot be applied. Ask an admin to reconcile the tank's deliveries first.
SWAP_CREATES_THREE_CONSECUTIVE_SHIFTS: Swapping to this operator would create 3 consecutive shifts.
TANKER_QUANTITY_MISMATCH: Total quantity {{totalQuantity}}L does not match tanker '{{tankerName}}' capacity of {{tankerCapacity}}L. Adjust the quantities so they add up to the tanker's capacity.
TANK_DECOMMISSION_NEEDS_ENDPOINT: Use the decommission endpoint to permanently remove a tank.
TANK_DISABLED_FOR_DELIVERY: Tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' is currently disabled. Re-enable it in Setup before recording a delivery.
TANK_DISABLED_FOR_DIP_CHECK: Tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' is currently disabled. Re-enable it in Setup before recording a DIP check.
TANK_HAS_NO_DELIVERY: Tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' has never received a delivery. Record a tanker delivery first before performing a DIP check.
TANK_NAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: A tank named '{{tankIdentifier}}' already exists on this pump.
THREE_CONSECUTIVE_SHIFTS: Cannot assign: this would give the operator 3 consecutive shifts. A minimum rest period is required between every 2 shifts.
TOO_MANY_BALANCE_LOOKUPS: Too many balance lookups. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes before trying again.
TOO_MANY_PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTS: Too many password reset requests. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes before trying again.
TOO_MANY_SHIFT_DEFINITIONS: A pump can have at most {{maxShifts}} shifts. Received: {{receivedShifts}}
UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS: Another update is in progress, please retry.
USER_PHONE_ALREADY_EXISTS: A user with this phone number already exists
VOID_REASON_REQUIRED: A mandatory void reason is required.
WAIVER_REASON_REQUIRED: A mandatory reason is required when waiving a discrepancy (Business Rule 19).
ADJUSTMENT_OWNER_OR_ADMIN_ONLY: Only Owner or Admin can record reading adjustments and dip entries.
DATE_RANGE_END_IN_FUTURE: 'to' date cannot be in the future
DATE_RANGE_TOO_LONG: Choose a date range of at most {{maxDays}} days
RECEIPT_NOZZLE_READINGS_MISSING: Enter the before and after meter readings of every nozzle on tank {{tankIdentifier}} ({{nozzleNumbers}}).
RECEIPT_READING_FOR_UNMAPPED_NOZZLE: A meter reading was entered for a nozzle that does not draw from tank {{tankIdentifier}}. Reload and enter the readings again.
RECEIPT_AFTER_READING_BELOW_BEFORE: Nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}}: the reading after unloading ({{readingAfter}}) is below the reading before ({{readingBefore}}).
RECEIVED_LITRES_NOT_POSITIVE: The dips and readings for tank {{tankIdentifier}} work out to {{receivedLitres}} L received. Check the dips before and after unloading.
SHORTAGE_CLAIM_NOT_RAISED: This claim is already {{statusCode}}; only a raised claim can be settled or rejected.
SHORTAGE_CLAIM_CLOSED_FOR_DELIVERY: The shortage claim on invoice {{invoiceReference}} is {{statusCode}}, so its quantity and cost can no longer change.
CREDIT_NOTE_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The credit note date cannot be in the future.
CREDIT_NOTE_EXCEEDS_INVOICE_VALUE: The credit note of ₹{{creditNoteAmount}} is more than the delivery's invoice value of ₹{{invoiceValue}}.
RECEIPT_TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The short / over tolerance must be above 0 and at most 5%.
DENSITY_TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The density tolerance must be above 0 and at most 50 kg/m³.
DENOMINATIONS_TOTAL_MISMATCH: The notes and coins counted add up to ₹{{denominationTotal}}, but the amount entered is ₹{{amount}}.
CASH_DROP_SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: Cash can only be dropped from an open shift. This shift is {{statusCode}}.
CASH_DROP_NOT_OWN_SHIFT: You can only drop cash from your own open shift.
CASH_DROP_SELF_CONFIRMATION: Someone other than the person who recorded this drop must confirm it.
CASH_DROPS_PENDING_AT_CLOSE: {{count}} cash drop(s) worth ₹{{amount}} from this shift are waiting for confirmation. Confirm or reject them before closing.
CASH_EVENT_TYPE_NOT_MANUAL: {{eventTypeCode}} movements are recorded by confirming a cash drop or recording a bank deposit.
BANK_DEPOSIT_EXCEEDS_SAFE_BALANCE: A deposit of ₹{{amount}} is more than the ₹{{balance}} the safe holds.
BANK_DEPOSIT_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The deposit date cannot be in the future.
BANK_DEPOSIT_SLIP_REFERENCE_USED: A deposit with slip reference {{slipReference}} is already recorded.
BANK_LINE_RECORD_ALREADY_MATCHED: {{recordTypeCode}} #{{recordId}} is already matched to another bank line ({{txnDate}}). Unmatch that line first.
BANK_LINE_IGNORE_REASON_REQUIRED: Say why this line is ignored, for example bank charges or a transfer between own accounts.
BANK_LINE_NO_SUGGESTION: This line has no suggestion to accept. Match it by hand instead.
BANK_LINE_DIRECTION_MISMATCH: A {{recordTypeCode}} cannot be matched to this line: money in matches settlements, deposits and customer payments, money out matches supplier payments.
BANK_STATEMENT_DATE_FORMAT_AMBIGUOUS: The statement's dates mix day-first and month-first order. Choose the date format and import again.
BANK_STATEMENT_NOTHING_NEW: All {{count}} line(s) of this statement were already imported. Nothing new to add.
DEPOSIT_SLIP_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: The slip must be a JPEG or PNG photo or a PDF.
DEPOSIT_SLIP_TOO_LARGE: The slip file must be at most {{maxMb}} MB.
DEPOSIT_SLIP_EMPTY: Choose a photo or PDF of the deposit slip.
SAFE_COUNT_TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The safe count tolerance must be between ₹0 and ₹{{max}}.
SAFE_COUNT_DATE_IN_FUTURE: A safe count cannot be recorded for {{date}}, which has not begun.
SAFE_COUNT_BACK_DATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only an owner or admin can record a safe count for {{date}} after {{cutoffTime}} the next morning.
SAFE_COUNT_BACK_DATE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for recording a safe count for {{date}}.
DAY_CLOSED: {{date}} is closed. An owner or admin must re-open the day before it can be changed.
DAY_CLOSE_SAFE_COUNT_MISSING: {{date}} cannot be closed: no safe count was recorded on that day.
DAY_CLOSE_PRICES_MISSING: {{date}} cannot be closed: set or confirm the next day's fuel prices first.
DAY_CLOSE_DATE_IN_FUTURE: {{date}} has not happened yet, so it cannot be closed.
DAY_CLOSE_APPROVE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only an owner or admin can approve a day.
DAY_CLOSE_OPEN_SHIFTS: {{date}} cannot be closed: close or hand over its {{count}} open shift(s) first.
DAY_CLOSE_PENDING_APPROVALS: {{date}} cannot be closed: {{count}} expense(s) or credit payment(s) of {{amount}} dated that day still wait for approval.
SHIFT_AMEND_NOT_CLOSED: Only a closed shift can be amended; close it instead.
SHIFT_AMEND_NOZZLE_NOT_IN_SHIFT: Nozzle {{nozzleId}} was not part of this shift.
SHIFT_AMEND_LATER_SHIFT_ON_NOZZLE: A later shift has already started on nozzle(s) {{nozzleNumbers}} from this shift's closing reading, so the reading cannot be changed. Correct the collections only, or record a meter adjustment.
SHIFT_AMEND_BELOW_SETTLED: {{paymentTypeCode}} of this shift cannot go below ₹{{lowest}}: ₹{{settled}} of the pump's {{paymentTypeCode}} collections is already settled. Void the settlement first.
SHIFT_AMEND_DISCREPANCY_SETTLED: This shift's discrepancy was settled by {{resolutionCode}}, so its figures can no longer be amended.
SHIFT_AMEND_NO_CHANGE: The amended figures are the same as the shift's current figures.
CASH_OPENING_BALANCE_OWNER_ONLY: Only an owner or admin can record the safe's opening balance.
CASH_OPENING_BALANCE_EXISTS: The safe already has an opening balance. Reverse it first if it was wrong.
CASH_EVENT_NOT_REVERSIBLE: Only an opening balance, cash in or cash out typed by hand can be reversed.
CASH_EVENT_ALREADY_REVERSED: This cash movement is already reversed.
SUPPLIER_INACTIVE: {{supplierName}} is inactive. Re-activate the supplier before recording a payment.
SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_DATE_IN_FUTURE: A supplier payment cannot be dated in the future.
SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_REFERENCE_DUPLICATE: A payment to {{supplierName}} with reference {{referenceNo}} is already recorded.
SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_ALREADY_VOIDED: This supplier payment is already voided.
CREDIT_ON_HOLD: Credit is on hold for '{{clientName}}': {{daysOverdue}} days overdue, and credit is held from {{holdDays}} days. The client must pay, or an Owner/Admin must override the hold.
REMINDER_STAGES_INVALID: Reminder stages must be different days from 1 to {{maxDays}}, at most {{maxStages}}.
CREDIT_HOLD_DAYS_OUT_OF_RANGE: Credit hold days must be from 1 to {{maxDays}}, or empty to turn the hold off.
UPI_DETAILS_INCOMPLETE: Enter both the UPI ID and the payee name, or leave both empty.
UPI_ID_INVALID: '{{upiId}}' is not a UPI ID. It looks like name@bank, e.g. ramfuels@okaxis.
UPI_PAYEE_NAME_INVALID: The payee name can use letters, digits, spaces and . & ' - only, up to 100 characters.
CREDIT_REMINDER_CLIENT_NOT_OVERDUE: '{{clientName}}' is not overdue, so there is nothing to remind them of.
CREDIT_PROMISE_ALREADY_OPEN: '{{clientName}}' already promised ₹{{amount}} by {{promisedDate}}. Wait until that promise is kept or missed.
CREDIT_PROMISE_DATE_IN_PAST: The promised date cannot be before today.
VEHICLE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: '{{registration}}' is not a vehicle registration number. Use letters and digits, e.g. MH12AB1234.
VEHICLE_REGISTRATION_TAKEN: Vehicle {{registration}} is already listed as an active vehicle at this pump.
VEHICLE_CHECK_ON_SUB_ACCOUNT: The vehicle check of sub-account '{{clientName}}' is set on its parent account.
VEHICLE_NOT_ON_ACCOUNT: That vehicle is not one of '{{clientName}}''s vehicles. Pick it again.
VEHICLE_INACTIVE: Vehicle {{registration}} is deactivated and cannot take credit.
VEHICLE_REQUIRED_FOR_CREDIT: '{{clientName}}' gives credit only to its listed vehicles. Pick the vehicle.
VEHICLE_NOT_APPROVED: Vehicle {{registration}} is not on '{{clientName}}''s approved list, so it cannot take credit. Ask a manager to add it on the client's Vehicles tab.
VEHICLE_FUEL_NOT_ALLOWED: Vehicle {{registration}} may not take {{fuelType}} on credit.
VEHICLE_MONTHLY_LITRE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Vehicle {{registration}} has used {{used}} L of its monthly limit of {{limit}} L; this entry of {{requested}} L is more than the {{left}} L left.
VEHICLE_MONTHLY_AMOUNT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Vehicle {{registration}} has used ₹{{used}} of its monthly limit of ₹{{limit}}; this entry of ₹{{requested}} is more than the ₹{{left}} left.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED: This payment has already been reversed.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_NOT_REVERSIBLE: Only an approved payment can be reversed; this one is {{statusCode}}. Reject a payment that is still waiting for approval.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_REVERSAL_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required to reverse a payment.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_MATCHED_TO_BANK_LINE: This payment is matched to a bank statement line. Unmatch it in bank reconciliation first.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: A {{modeCode}} payment needs its reference (UTR, transaction ID or cheque number).
CREDIT_PAYMENT_POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: Possible duplicate: a payment with reference {{referenceNo}} (₹{{amount}}, dated {{paidAt}}) was already recorded in the last 90 days. Check it, then record again to confirm.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_CHEQUE_DETAILS_NOT_CHEQUE: Cheque bank and cheque date can only be given for a cheque payment.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_CHEQUE_NOT_DUE: This cheque is dated {{chequeDate}}, so it can be approved from that date.
BACKDATED_PAYMENT_DAYS_OUT_OF_RANGE: Back-dated payment days must be from 0 to {{maxDays}}.
CREDIT_PAYMENT_THRESHOLD_INVALID: The credit payment approval amount must be more than ₹0 and at most ₹{{maxAmount}}, in rupees and paise, or empty for no limit.
IMPORT_NO_ROWS: The file has no rows to import.
IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: A file can hold at most {{maxRows}} rows. Split it into smaller files.
IMPORT_FILE_HAS_ERRORS: {{errorCount}} row(s) have problems. Fix them and upload the file again; nothing was imported.
IMPORT_TOO_MANY_DECIMALS: Use at most {{decimals}} digits after the decimal point.
IMPORT_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future.
IMPORT_DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: Same as row {{firstRow}} of this file.
IMPORT_ALREADY_EXISTS: Already added, so this row is skipped.
IMPORT_RATE_NOT_FOR_ROLE: Leave this blank for {{roleCode}}: operators are paid by the hour, other staff by the day.
IMPORT_PARENT_NOT_FOUND: No main client named "{{parentName}}" in this file or at the pump.
IMPORT_PARENT_ROW_HAS_ERRORS: The main client on row {{parentRow}} has problems; fix that row first.
IMPORT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ON_SUB_ACCOUNT: A sub-account shares its main client's limit. Leave this blank.
IMPORT_CREDIT_LIMIT_REQUIRED: Enter a credit limit: an amount, 0 for no credit, or unlimited. The pump's limit for new clients is ₹0.
IMPORT_PHONE_IN_OTHER_GROUP: Row {{firstRow}} uses this phone for a different client group.
IMPORT_COST_REQUIRED_FOR_STOCK: Enter the cost per unit of the opening stock.
IMPORT_TANK_NOT_FOUND: No tank named "{{tankIdentifier}}" at this pump.
IMPORT_TANK_ALREADY_HAS_STOCK: Tank "{{tankIdentifier}}" already holds stock, so this row is skipped.
DEMO_PUMP_ALREADY_EXISTS: A demo pump already exists. Delete it before creating a new one.
DEMO_PUMP_NOT_FOUND: There is no demo pump to delete.
DEMO_PUMP_DELETE_BLOCKED: The demo pump is linked to records of another pump, such as a staff member moved there. Move them back before deleting the demo pump.
CREDIT_LIMIT_ABOVE_MANAGER_CAP: Managers can set a credit limit up to {{cap}}. Ask an Owner or Admin for a higher limit.
CREDIT_LIMIT_UNLIMITED_OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner or Admin can give a client unlimited credit.
CREDIT_LIMIT_ON_SUB_ACCOUNT: '{{clientName}}' is a sub-account. Its credit limit is set on the main account '{{parentName}}'.
CREDIT_CLOSE_BLOCKED_CLIENTS: The shift can't close with credit for blocked clients. Over limit: {{overLimitClients}}. On hold: {{onHoldClients}}. Overdue: {{overdueClients}}. Record a payment, remove those entries, or ask an Owner/Admin to allow blocked credit.
CREDIT_CLOSE_OVERRIDE_OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner or Admin can allow credit for blocked clients.
CREDIT_CLOSE_OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for allowing credit to blocked clients.
PORTAL_PIN_TOO_EASY: Choose a PIN that is hard to guess: not one digit repeated, not a run like 123456, and not a common PIN.
CREDIT_CLIENT_PHONE_CHANGE_OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner or Admin can change a client's phone number.
CREDIT_CLIENT_GSTIN_CHANGE_OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner or Admin can change a client's GSTIN.
CREDIT_CLIENT_ENABLE_OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner or Admin can enable a disabled client.
CREDIT_CLIENT_NAME_AMBIGUOUS: More than one client is named '{{clientName}}'. Pick the client from the list.
METER_ADJUSTMENT_ALREADY_PENDING: A meter adjustment for this nozzle is already waiting for approval.
METER_ADJUSTMENT_NOT_PENDING: This meter adjustment is not waiting for approval (it is {{statusCode}}).
METER_ADJUSTMENT_READING_MOVED: The nozzle's reading changed from {{expectedReading}} to {{currentReading}} since this adjustment was asked for. Ask for a new adjustment.
METER_ADJUSTMENT_NO_TANK: This nozzle is not linked to a tank, so its unbilled litres cannot be taken from stock.
METER_ADJUSTMENT_NO_PRICE: There is no current price for {{fuelTypeCode}}, so the unbilled litres cannot be valued.
EARLY_START_GRACE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Early start grace must be between 0 and {{max}} minutes.
ROUNDING_TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Rounding allowance must be between ₹0 and ₹{{max}}.
SHIFT_WINDOW_NOT_OPENABLE_NOW: That shift window cannot be opened now. Choose the current window, or the next one when it starts within the pump's early start grace.
PRICE_CHANGE_METER_READINGS_MISSING: {{openNozzleCount}} open {{fuelTypeCode}} nozzle(s) need their current meter reading, so the litres sold before the change keep the old price.
PRICE_CHANGE_READING_FOR_NOZZLE_WITHOUT_: A meter reading was entered for a nozzle that is not on an open shift selling {{fuelTypeCode}}. The shift may have just closed — reload and enter the readings again.
PRICE_CHANGE_READING_BELOW_LAST: Meter reading {{meterReading}} for nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}} is below its last known reading {{lastReading}}.
CLOSING_READING_BELOW_PRICE_CHANGE: Closing reading {{closingReading}} is below the reading {{priceChangeReading}} taken for the {{fuelTypeCode}} nozzle when the price changed. Please verify the meter reading.
WAIVER_BY_CLOSER_NOT_ALLOWED: You closed this shift, so you cannot waive its discrepancy. Ask another manager or the owner.
CASH_RECOVERY_AMOUNT_INVALID: The amount recovered must be more than ₹0 and at most the shortage of ₹{{maxAmount}}.
CASH_RECOVERY_ALREADY_RECORDED: ₹{{amount}} was already recovered for this shift. Resolve the rest by salary deduction or waiver.
OPERATOR_SHIFT_OPENED_CONCURRENTLY: {{operatorName}} was just given another open shift. Refresh the page to see it.
BANK_DEPOSIT_LEAVES_SAFE_NEGATIVE: A deposit of ₹{{amount}} dated {{depositDate}} would leave the safe below zero on a later day, when it held only ₹{{lowestBalance}}. Record it on a later date.
